decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting but distinct claims regarding Harry J. Mott, III's education. Document 1 (D1S9, D1S13) states he attended the 'Academy of Fine Arts, Prague' and the 'United States Military Academy at West Point'. Document 2 (D2S5, D2S22) asserts he attended 'Adelphi University'. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat audits as fallible without equating competing assertions, all three institutions are retained as valid answers derived from the source text.
